title: should render Status Steps Used and Total columns in the org list
verifies: the meta-org admin list surfaces the two new Status Steps columns with correct headers and numeric, comma-formatted cells

title: should set the Status Steps allowance from the Status Steps tab
verifies: an admin opens the usage-limits dialog, sets a new Status Steps limit, and the row's Status Steps Total cell updates after save

title: should show its own wording and used-count on the Status Steps tab
verifies: the Status Steps tab renders its own title/subtitle/label and the status-steps used-count, distinct from the protocol tab

title: should reject non-integer and negative Status Steps values
verifies: the Status Steps limit input blocks fractional and negative values with a validation error and keeps the dialog open

title: should expose status-step fields via the admin org-list API
verifies: GET /api/_meta/organizations returns status_steps_used and status_steps_limit as numbers per org
